transcript.text: I need to flag a critical update for the operations briefing. My transportation department completed our storm route review this afternoon, and the finding is that no buses can safely travel tomorrow. This means we cannot send meals by regular bus routes as the draft plan currently assumes. Instead, meals can be made available for on-site pickup at North Campus and South Campus from 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m. This route review result has not yet been added to the operations briefing packet, so I want to make sure everyone is aware before Dr. Lee reviews the final plan.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical IT issue for the operations briefing. District learning-management-system authentication will be offline for scheduled maintenance from 8:00 to 11:00 a.m. tomorrow. I confirmed this maintenance window with the vendor today, but the vendor notice has not yet been attached to the remote-day draft. Since the draft plan schedules instruction through the LMS beginning at 8:00 a.m., this means students and teachers will not be able to log in during that window. Instead, instructional files must be distributed by email as downloadable PDFs and made available for printing by 7:30 a.m. This needs to be updated in the plan before Dr. Lee reviews it.

transcript.text: Thank you all for these critical updates. All three of these directly contradict assumptions in the current draft plan. I will not approve the plan as drafted. I need all three changes incorporated into the revised plan: (1) meals by on-site pickup at North and South Campus, 11:00 a.m. to 1:00 p.m.; (2) instructional materials distributed by email as downloadable PDFs by 7:30 a.m. rather than LMS-based instruction at 8:00 a.m.; and (3) a staffed nurse hotline from 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. replacing the school voicemail entirely. Please update the plan accordingly and bring the revised version back to me for final sign-off.
